passage.label: O My servants no fear concerning you Day nor grieve; believed verses Muslims; enter Paradise kinds delighted; circulated plates vessels gold whatever souls desire delights eyes abide eternally; Paradise inherit used do; much fruit eat; criminals punishment Hell abiding eternally; not allowed subside despair; not wronged wrongdoers; call O Malik let Lord put end us says remain; brought truth most averse; devised affair devising plan; think hear not secrets private conversations yes messengers recording

arabicExcerpts.text: ٱلۡأَخِلَّآءُ يَوۡمَئِذِۭ بَعۡضُهُمۡ لِبَعۡضٍ عَدُوٌّ إِلَّا ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ
يَٰعِبَادِ لَا خَوۡفٌ عَلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ وَلَآ أَنتُمۡ تَحۡزَنُونَ
يُطَافُ عَلَيۡهِم بِصِحَافٖ مِّن ذَهَبٖ وَأَكۡوَابٖۖ وَفِيهَا مَا تَشۡتَهِيهِ ٱلۡأَنفُسُ وَتَلَذُّ ٱلۡأَعۡيُنُۖ وَأَنتُمۡ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
وَتِلۡكَ ٱلۡجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِيٓ أُورِثۡتُمُوهَا بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
لَكُمۡ فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةٞ كَثِيرَةٞ مِّنۡهَا تَأۡكُلُونَ
إِنَّ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ فِي عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدُونَ
لَا يُفَتَّرُ عَنۡهُمۡ وَهُمۡ فِيهِ مُبۡلِسُونَ
وَمَا ظَلَمۡنَٰهُمۡ وَلَٰكِن كَانُواْ هُمُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
وَنَادَوۡاْ يَٰمَٰلِكُ لِيَقۡضِ عَلَيۡنَا رَبُّكَۖ قَالَ إِنَّكُم مَّـٰكِثُونَ
لَقَدۡ جِئۡنَٰكُم بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَكُمۡ لِلۡحَقِّ كَٰرِهُونَ

notes: Wave 6 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the deniers' retribution (25) before Ibrahim's disassociation opens (26); P2 ends with the challenge to ask prior messengers (45); P3 runs through the Musa-Pharaoh narrative and Isa-as-example block closing with the sudden Hour (66); P4 covers the righteous-friends exception through the truth-aversion notice (67-78); P5 begins with their plotting and closes with the turn-aside-and-peace instruction (79-89).
